title: Limite 1B targets competition maths with a compact specialist model
friendlyTitle: A small new AI model focuses only on difficult maths
summary: Paradigma has released Limite 1B–Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model trained for high-throughput mathematical reasoning, along with evaluations, a value model and a vLLM inference plugin. The company reports strong competition-maths results for its size but openly shows serious failures on ordinary instructions outside the model’s narrow scope.
friendlySummary: Limite 1B is a compact model built for competition-level maths. Its makers also show that it can give very poor answers to normal questions that are not mathematical.
whyItMatters: Small specialist models can be cheaper to run and easier to deploy than general assistants when the job is tightly defined. Limite’s candid failure examples are equally useful: route only suitable maths problems to it and validate answers independently rather than placing it in a general-purpose chat workflow.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A small specialist model may do one job efficiently, but it should not be treated as a general assistant. Use it only for suitable maths tasks and check every important answer.
